Reproduction Steps: 1. Create hotel booking with paymentOption='advance_30' 2. Check out booking 3. Call GET /api/partner/payouts
Expected Result: Ledger remittance should deduct cash balance collected directly by hotel desk ($balanceAmount)
Actual Result: Ledger calculates grossForHotel minus commission minus gatewayCharges without subtracting balanceAmount
Root Cause If Confirmed: Missing subtraction of balanceAmount in Mongo aggregation expression $$net in netPayableRemittanceBalance
Business Impact: Severe financial leakage: Platform pays out money it never collected (overpays hotel by ~70% of tariff)
Proposed Fix: Update aggregate query in partner.routes.js:522 and 605 to subtract balanceAmount from gross earnings before calculating payout

Reproduction Steps: 1. Open https://www.vrindavansarthi.com/ in browser or run curl -ILs https://www.vrindavansarthi.com/
Expected Result: Should return HTTP 301 redirecting to https://www.vrindavansarthi.in/
Actual Result: Returns HTTP 200 OK serving duplicate SPA site directly under .com
Evidence: Live curl output: HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: Vercel
Root Cause If Confirmed: Vercel domain configuration treats both .in and .com as primary target domains without domain-level 301 redirect
Business Impact: Split domain authority; Google duplicate content indexing penalties across .in and .com
Proposed Fix: Configure Vercel Domain settings to permanently redirect vrindavansarthi.com and www.vrindavansarthi.com to www.vrindavansarthi.in

Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect canonical link tag on https://www.vrindavansarthi.in/ 2. Follow canonical URL
Expected Result: Canonical should point to 200 OK destination (https://www.vrindavansarthi.in/)
Actual Result: Canonical tag points to https://vrindavansarthi.in/ which 308-redirects to www.vrindavansarthi.in/
Root Cause If Confirmed: SITE_ORIGIN defined as apex domain (without www) while Vercel redirects apex to www
Business Impact: Search engines reject canonical tag due to redirect loop; pages flagged as 'Page with redirect'
Proposed Fix: Update SITE_ORIGIN in frontend/src/lib/seo.ts and index.html:23 to https://www.vrindavansarthi.in

Reproduction Steps: 1. Open hotel room detail page /room-types/:id 2. Fill details and click Book Now
Expected Result: Commercial hotels should offer Instant Booking (pay upfront and get instant confirmation)
Actual Result: All room bookings force two-step request flow (pending_property_confirmation); user cannot pay until partner accepts
Root Cause If Confirmed: Main booking route unconditionally returns createDharamshalaRequest; lines 490-570 instant checkout logic is unreachable dead code
Business Impact: High booking abandonment; users abandon checkout when told property must review request
Proposed Fix: Implement instant booking mode for approved commercial hotels while preserving request flow for Dharamshalas

Expected Result: Sitemap URLs should return 200 OK directly
Actual Result: Every URL in sitemap uses non-www prefix (https://vrindavansarthi.in/...) and returns 308 redirect
Root Cause If Confirmed: Static sitemap files generated with apex domain prefix
Business Impact: Search engine crawlers report error: 'Sitemap contains URLs that redirect to other locations'
Proposed Fix: Update sitemap XML files to reference https://www.vrindavansarthi.in/ and build dynamic sitemap generator endpoint

Actual Result: Contains only 10 static landing page URLs; dynamic properties are omitted

Expected Result: Should display clear message and 'Find Another Hotel' action button
Actual Result: Renders empty card because canFindAnotherDharamshala is gated by isDharamshalaBooking

Business Impact: Customer is left stranded with a dead-end page upon hotel request rejection or expiration
Proposed Fix: Update condition in BookingDetail.tsx to display recovery card and link to /hotels for hotel rejections as well

Reproduction Steps: 1. Trigger forgot password or partner registration without SMTP/Resend configured
Expected Result: Should reliably send email or surface clear operational warning in admin dashboard
Actual Result: Silently falls back to logging OTP in console or fails without delivery
Root Cause If Confirmed: Production Render environment lacks active RESEND_API_KEY or verified sender domain
Business Impact: Users cannot self-reset passwords; partner registration alerts fail to reach admin inbox
Proposed Fix: Configure RESEND_API_KEY and verified RESEND_FROM domain in Render production dashboard

Reproduction Steps: 1. Deploy multiple API instances on Render 2. Attempt repeated brute-force attacks
Expected Result: Rate limits should be tracked globally across all API instances
Actual Result: Rate limiter buckets are stored in local Node.js process memory
Root Cause If Confirmed: In-memory Map used for rate limiting buckets
Business Impact: An attacker can bypass rate limits by distributing requests across multiple Render backend replicas
Proposed Fix: Migrate rate limiters to use Redis store via rate-limiter-flexible
